mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST decline > 0.5% MoM) during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals aggressive policy restraint, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% during a tightening cycle, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
